title: One engine inoperative second segment climb
objective: To demonstrate that the simulation of engine thrust, aerodynamic drag and atmosphere in an engine out second segment climb condition conforms to the validation data.
tolerance_catalog: ± 3 kts airspeed | ± 5% or ± 0.5 m/s (100 ft/min) R/C but not less than applicable AFM values
runtime_configuration: Existing main.py test settings and common engine remain authoritative
